fields.name: the cyber showdown
fields.details: Participated in the AI vs Cybersecurity session, exploring the relationship between artificial intelligence and modern cybersecurity practices. The session covered emerging AI technologies, cyber threats, ethical concerns, and the role of AI in strengthening digital security and threat detection systems.

fields.name: start it back
fields.details: Participated in the A Start-It-Up Pre-Event Talk Session, gaining insights into entrepreneurship, startup culture, innovation, and business development through expert-led discussions and interactive sessions. The event helped build understanding of startup ecosystems, idea validation, and opportunities for aspiring entrepreneurs.

fields.name: Engineering Beyond Classroom
fields.details:
Participated in “Engineering Beyond Classroom” conducted by CSI, which focused on exploring practical applications of technology and learning beyond academic theory. The program encouraged innovation, teamwork, problem-solving, and industry-oriented thinking through interactive sessions and technical activities.
Gained exposure to real-world engineering concepts, collaborative project approaches, and emerging technologies while improving communication and technical skills in a professional learning environment.

fields.name: Game Craft
fields.details:
Designed and developed a beginner-friendly endless runner game inspired by Subway Surfers using Unity. The project focused on implementing core game development concepts such as character movement, obstacle spawning, collision detection, scoring systems, and smooth gameplay mechanics.
Worked on creating an interactive gaming environment with simple controls and engaging level design to provide an enjoyable experience for new players. The project also helped strengthen practical skills in Unity game development, game physics, and UI integration.

fields.name: Flutter Flow
fields.details:
Participated in a FlutterFlow App Development workshop focused on building modern mobile applications using low-code development tools. The workshop covered UI design, app logic, backend integration, and rapid prototyping techniques for cross-platform application development.
Gained hands-on experience in designing responsive mobile interfaces, creating functional app workflows, and understanding the fundamentals of app deployment and user experience design using FlutterFlow.

fields.name: Mercedes-Benz EV Workshop
fields.details:
Participated in the Mercedes-Benz EV Workshop focused on the future of electric vehicles and sustainable automotive technology. The workshop provided insights into EV architecture, battery technology, charging systems, and innovations shaping the modern automobile industry.
Gained exposure to real-world advancements in electric mobility, automotive engineering concepts, and the technological transition from traditional vehicles to intelligent EV systems. The session also enhanced understanding of industry trends, sustainability, and next-generation transportation solutions.
